E1.evidence: Issue #552 quotes the Travis log with the error "xacro.XacroException: Parameters [has_podest] were not set for macro xacro:schunk_pg70" while processing cob_hardware_config/cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro; the maintainer fixes it in PR #553 ("fixes #552").

E2.evidence: schunk_description (ipa320/schunk_modular_robotics) and cob_hardware_config (ipa320/cob_robots) are separately released packages. The provider changed the declaration of its xacro macro in 779ce503 (PR #177): <xacro:macro name="schunk_pg70" params="parent name *origin"> became <xacro:macro name="schunk_pg70" params="parent name *origin has_podest">, adding a parameter without a default. The consumer's cob3-9.urdf.xacro still invokes <xacro:schunk_pg70 name="pg70" parent="arm_7_link"> without it. The fix edits the consumer's macro call to follow the provider's changed declaration; this is an interface change, not a name binding at deployment or a build-system change.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the CI built schunk_modular_robotics from source at branch indigo_dev (care-o-bot .travis.rosinstall: uri 'https://github.com/ipa320/schunk_modular_robotics.git', version: indigo_dev), i.e. at 870c6302 on the report date, which is newer than the macro declaration the consumer's call matches (before 779ce503).

E4.evidence: Observed failure: "xacro.XacroException: Parameters [has_podest] were not set for macro xacro:schunk_pg70" and "Invalid <param> tag: Cannot load command parameter [robot_description]: command [...xacro.py '.../cob3-9.urdf.xacro'] returned with code [1]."

notes: Detected by roslaunch-check in the catkin test run on Travis (roslaunch-check_cob3-9__ROBOT_ENV_ipa-factory.xml), which is why detection_stage is build; the same error would occur when launching upload_robot.launch. consumer_built_against (broken) is inferred: 08471b26 is the parent of 779ce503 and the last provider revision whose schunk_pg70 params are "parent name *origin", matching the consumer's call.
